entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout

entities.evidence: KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch alert (critical) and KubePodNotReady alert for pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq; PendingPodsDetected alert shows a pending pod in namespace.

entities.reasoning: Pod shows 43% CPU throttling, indicating resource starvation that can degrade DB latency for services.
entities.evidence: CPUThrottlingHigh alert (warning) reporting 43.1% throttling for container postgresql in this pod.
